about: Maker spec lengths (mm) for every RTX 5070 Ti model in the demo listings (issue #96). MIRROR: read from each maker's own spec page or datasheet. MSI and ASUS pages refuse direct fetches, so the figure was read through a search index restricted to the maker's domain; the source URL is the maker page. confidence: exact = the maker page for this exact model; family = a sibling SKU's maker page (noted).
